component.name: WhatsApp for COSMIC
component.summary: Unofficial native WhatsApp client for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: A native Rust client built with libcosmic. It links to your phone as a WhatsApp linked device by scanning a QR code, and supports chats and groups, replies, reactions, images, stickers, voice notes, documents, desktop notifications.

This is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta. Using unofficial clients may violate the WhatsApp Terms of Service and could lead to your account being banned.
